products.name: Pregnacare Original
products.ingredients: Maltodextrin; magnesium oxide; microcrystalline cellulose; ascorbic acid; ferrous fumarate; zinc sulphate; coating (hydroxypropylmethylcellulose, polydextrose, medium-chain triglycerides, talc, calcium carbonate, iron oxides); silicon dioxide, stearic acid, magnesium stearate; nicotinamide; pyridoxine hydrochloride; beta-carotene; calcium pantothenate; cyanocobalamin; D-alpha-tocopheryl acid succinate (SOYA); cholecalciferol; thiamin mononitrate; riboflavin; copper sulphate; phytomenadione; pteroylmonoglutamic acid; potassium iodide; biotin; sodium selenate. Nutritional declaration: Per tablet: vitamin D 10 µg (200% NRV); E 4 mg α-TE (33%); K 70 µg (93%); C 70 mg (88%); B1 3 mg (273%); B2 2 mg (143%); niacin 20 mg NE (125%); B6 10 mg (714%); folic acid 400 µg (200%); B12 6 µg (240%); biotin 150 µg (300%); pantothenic acid 6 mg (100%); magnesium 150 mg (40%); iron 17 mg (121%); zinc 15 mg (150%); copper 1000 µg (100%); selenium 30 µg (55%); iodine 150 µg (100%); beta-carotene 2 mg (NRV not established).
products.allergens: Contains SOYA. The manufacturer reports possible NUT and PEANUT handling at the facility; the product is unsuitable for people allergic to nuts or peanuts. Confirm the current pack.
products.directions: One tablet a day, with the main meal and on a full stomach. Swallow whole with water or a cold drink; do not chew.
products.precautions: Food supplement; do not exceed the stated intake or use in place of a varied diet and healthy lifestyle. Seek advice if medically supervised, allergic to ingredients, or affected by epilepsy, thyroid conditions or haemochromatosis. Vitamin K: people taking anticoagulants should use only on medical advice. Excess iron can harm young children. Store dry below 25°C, out of children's sight and reach.

products.name: Feroglobin Liquid
products.ingredients: Purified water; cane sugar (sucrose); malt extract (BARLEY); glucose liquid (SULPHITES); honey; lysine hydrochloride; ferric ammonium citrate; zinc sulphate; ascorbic acid; xanthan gum; nicotinamide; calcium glycerophosphate; mixed carotenes (polysorbate 80, carotene, medium-chain triglycerides, ascorbyl palmitate, DL-alpha tocopherol); thiamin hydrochloride; orange extract; beetroot red (beetroot concentrate, mono propylene glycol, ascorbic acid); citric acid; pyridoxine hydrochloride; potassium sorbate; D-panthenol; riboflavin sodium phosphate; copper sulphate; manganese sulphate; pteroylmonoglutamic acid; potassium iodide; cyanocobalamin. Nutritional declaration: Per 10 ml: C 20 mg (25% NRV); B1 8 mg (727%); B2 2 mg (143%); niacin 16 mg NE (100%); B6 4 mg (286%); folic acid 300 µg (150%); B12 10 µg (400%); pantothenic acid 4 mg (67%); iron 14 mg (100%); zinc 10 mg (100%); copper 500 µg (50%); manganese 0.5 mg (25%); iodine 80 µg (53%); lysine 80 mg; honey 200 mg; malt extract 1000 mg; calcium glycerophosphate 20 mg.
products.allergens: Contains BARLEY (GLUTEN) and SULPHITES. Facility may handle NUTS. Contains honey. Confirm current pack allergen declaration.
products.directions: Adults: 5 ml twice daily. Ages 3–6: 2.5 ml twice daily. Ages 7–12: 5 ml once or twice daily. Use the labelled measuring dose; do not exceed it.
products.precautions: Food supplement, not a replacement for a varied diet and healthy lifestyle. Seek professional advice if pregnant, breastfeeding, medically supervised, or affected by epilepsy, thyroid disorder, haemochromatosis or food allergies. Excess iron is dangerous to young children. Do not use if the bottle seal is damaged. Refrigerate after opening and finish within eight weeks. Before opening, keep dry below 25°C, away from children.
